messages:
Rae: Quick sign-up: Office yule-log (bûche) bake-off next Wednesday at 3pm. Amateur bakers welcome! Bring a slice for tasting and a tiny note with ingredients. :cake:
Omar: I'm in. Will attempt a very adventurous chocolate-espresso roulade. No guarantees on structural integrity. :coffee:
Bea: Count me in too. Going classic: chestnut and buttercream. Also volunteering to judge if needed. :yum:
Yuki: I can bring a gluten-free rolled cake option. Labeling will be clear. :white_check_mark:
Rae: Great. Logistics: table set up by the kitchen, plates and tasting forks provided. React with :one: if you want to compete, :two: if you just want to taste.
Omar: :one: baker
Bea: :one: baker + judge offer
Yuki: :one: baker (gluten-free entry)
Marta: :two: tasting only. Also can anyone bring an extra serrated knife? I have one but more is safer for sharing.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please follow food-safety guidelines. Label allergens and use serving utensils. Office policy: shared food must have an ingredient list. :information_source:
Rae: Thanks ops-bot. We'll have a sign-up sheet on the fridge for ingredient lists and a little card for each entry. Judges will be volunteer-based; winner gets a tiny ribbon and bragging rights.
Omar: Prize request: can the ribbon be gold? Or at least glitter-adjacent. :sparkles:
Bea: I'll make a small scoring rubric: taste, texture, creativity. Quick poll: do we want to include a "presentation" category? React :one: yes, :two: no.
Marta: :one: presentation matters for yule-logs
Yuki: :one: yes presentation
Rae: Poll leaning yes. Okay final call: bakers arrive 2:30pm for setup, tasting at 3pm. Remote folks can submit photos and ingredient lists and will be eligible for a "people's choice" virtual award. DM me to be included.
Bea: Love it. Also tiny PSA: if your recipe uses real egg wash, please bring a probe thermometer to ensure safe temps.
Omar: Noted. See you Wednesday. Will bring extra forks and a tiny espresso drip for dram shots. :espresso:
